note: [τ] check the least next prime, reusing recorded divisors when available

body.prime: within_range and all(w % d != 0 for d in range(2, isqrt(w) + 1))
body.without_recorded_divisor: [k for k in range(p + 1, w) if not any(1 < q and q * q <= k and k % q == 0 for q in primes)] if prime else []
body.result: prime and all(any(k % d == 0 for d in range(2, isqrt(k) + 1)) for k in without_recorded_divisor)
